author_reading.rationale: Toggle plus independently changing payload has no reset/startup event convention, payload stability envelope, or event-rate contract.

rationale: Only event_toggle and payload bit 0 reach out, through independent two-stage chains. There is no event detector or event-qualified payload capture. No rate, hold, startup convention or consumer contract establishes that these observations must form associated transactions. An event can be missed or misassociated under some patterns, but independent status observations remain possible; required behavior is unresolved. Physical synchronizer implementation and asynchronous reset release/recovery remain external obligations; neither SDC nor sampled digital simulation closes them.

labels.rationale: Parallel two-stage chains independently synchronize event_toggle and payload bit 0, but prove neither event rate nor payload association. A toggle can change twice before observation and related payload/control transitions can resolve on different cycles. No hold, rate, correlation or consumer contract is supplied. Independent level observations could be valid; transaction delivery cannot be certified.

The toggle and payload bit are separately synchronized and merely concatenated; there is no edge detector or qualified payload capture. No contract states whether the output is independent status or an event-associated payload, nor whether toggle spacing and payload stability are sufficient. The structure cannot prove associated delivery; the interface alone cannot establish that such delivery is required. Physical and reset closure are additional obligations.
